title: Starter Deck 24: GREEN Jewelry Bonney
note: Copiado da optcgapi.com para os testes e para o primeiro início do servidor. A importação (npm run cards:import) tem prioridade sobre estes dados.

cards.name: Scratchmen Apoo
cards.text: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the EB01 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Jewelry Bonney
cards.text: [On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] ① (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards.

cards.name: Urouge
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[End of Your Turn] Set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Caribou
cards.text: If you have 6 or more rested DON!! cards, this Character gains +1000 power.[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Coribou
cards.text: [On Play] Play up to 1 [Caribou] with a cost of 4 or less from your hand rested.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Bartolomeo
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If a Character is rested by your effect, draw 1 card and trash 1 card from your hand.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: If you have 3 or more Characters, your Characters with a cost of 3 or less other than [Monkey.D.Luffy] cannot be K.O.'d by your opponent's effects.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or more Characters, this Character gains +2000 power during this turn.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: Demonic Aura Nine-Sword Style Asura Demon Nine Flash
cards.text: [Main] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this turn. Then, you may rest 1 of your Characters with a cost of 3 or more. If you do, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less.
cards.trigger: Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

cards.name: More Pizza!!
cards.text: [Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Supernovas} type card other than [More Pizza!!] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP07 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.
